title: EvalFixture
description: One line of an evals/fixtures/*.jsonl file. Deterministic presence checks score responses; no LLM judge required.

prompt.description: The task given to the model

expected_facts.description: Facts that MUST survive compression (scored by presence in the response)

forbidden_loss.description: Constraints/nuances that must not be lost: uncertainty, trade-offs, conditions

reference_answer.description: Optional dense signal-coding style answer, for spot-checking and as documentation

required_terms.description: Optional exact terms the response must contain

required_conditions.description: Optional conditions the response must state

task_success_criteria.description: Optional success criteria; if present, task_success is graded from these
